_about: The technique table (27 Nov. 2026). Units are what a player learns (New game's technique list, campaign steps, drills, training), in teaching order: the order of this list is the only order there is. Each unit has a code that never changes and is never reused: stored data names units by code, so a unit can be inserted anywhere by giving it the next free code. Methods are what the solver applies (the technique numbers 0-19 in the weights, append-only as well), each belonging to one unit. Edit here, then run tools/grade/gen.py (it writes the table into the games' gradew.js and into java/src/SuguruGrade.java).

_fields.unit.code: stable identity (1-12 are the old level numbers; 13 is taken by 'cannot be done without guessing'; 14 the mixed triple, 28 Nov. 2026)
_fields.unit.family: basic | chain | whatif: the groups in New game's list; the what-if family is compared on effort as one tier
_fields.unit.rung: where the unit sits on the time curve (calib.js): time grows with rung^k
_fields.unit.drill: has a practice drill; otherwise practice is training boards that start where it is next
_fields.unit.rare: puzzles that need it are rare: New game warns that the search can take long
_fields.method.weight: the solver's preference within a unit (lower first)
_fields.method.pattern: a pattern on the board (neighbour elimination and the subsets): the grade's shape term, and tried first inside a what-if
_fields.method.inner: usable inside a what-if with techniques
_fields.method.byLength: priced by its length, like the what-ifs
_fields.method.within: a what-if: the unit whose techniques it uses along the way
